title: Creating an autobattler: Spiritwright
author: Kalaith
selftext:
One of those, someone mentions an autobattler at work, next day here is my autobattler! (I have worked on this for more then 1 day now)

This project was done in Godot withOpus 5.5 agent

The initial version felt interesting and it had a good bit of gameplay, so I expanded on it and I think overall its a fun and interesting game

Promo video
https://youtu.be/q1w3Zs1x6gA
I really should add vocals, maybe next promo video.

itch seems to be a bit slow at releasing new versions, so I do suggest playing the copy on webhatchery if you want to give it a try.
Play free in your browser
itch.io: https://kalaith.itch.io/spiritwright
WebHatchery: https://webhatchery.au/games/spiritwright/

the project is open source as well https://github.com/Kalaith/spiritwright

Spiritwright: collect spirits, build their golem bodies, and let the battle decide

In Spiritwright, the spirit is the hero and the body is yours to build. Rescue and recruit wandering spirits, then give each one a golem vessel. You choose the frame, arms, legs, material and sigil. Arrange your team on the board and watch your plan play out in an automated battle.

There's no mid-battle control. Your preparation is the game.

🔥 What's inside
• 28 spirits to collect. Find them on the map, earn them through challenges, or win them with extreme feats.
• A golem laboratory with frames, arms, legs and sigils that each change how a golem fights. Swap them freely.
• 8 materials that react with a spirit's element: Kindling, Steam, Glacier, Thunderglass and more.
• Up to 6v6 battles across three lanes and two rows, with burn, wards, stuns, chain lightning, executes and revives.
• Every result explained: see what each golem did and why the fight went the way it did.
• 5 regions and 30 stages, each region endin
• 60 challenges, plus a sigil for every region you master.                                                       
• The Shifting Crucible, a Boss Royale. Locks encounters and a final. Lose once and therun is over. Play the fixed Classic Royale, or a seeded Shifting Royale at Adept or Master tier, to earn titles, vessel finishes and Vesper, the Crucible Spi
• New Game+ when you want a harder second run.

▶️ Play free in your browser
itch.io: https://kalaith.itch.io/spiritwright
WebHatchery: https://webhatchery.au/games/spiritwright/
A Windows download is also available.

comments.author: NotSecure1102
comments.body:
Let’s be honest here — I didn’t read your post. And here’s why. 🧵



In today’s fast-paced digital landscape, authenticity matters more than ever. When I opened this thread, I wasn’t met with a human voice — I was met with a wall of AI-generated content. And frankly? That’s not just disappointing. It’s a symptom of something bigger.



Let’s delve into it. 👇



🔍 The Telltale Signs



Em dashes — everywhere — like confetti at a corporate retreat

“It’s not just X, it’s Y” framing (it’s not just lazy, it’s exhausting)

Bullet points with emojis that add absolutely nothing 🚀

A conclusion that restates the intro, but with more gravitas

💡 Why This Matters

Reddit was built on genuine human connection. Real stories. Real opinions. Real people sharing real experiences in real time. When we outsource our voice to a language model, we’re not just saving time. We’re trading away the very thing that makes community community.



🤝 A Path Forward

I’m not saying AI has no place. It’s a powerful tool for brainstorming, drafting, and refining ideas. But there’s a crucial difference between using a tool and becoming one.



TL;DR: Write your own posts. Your voice matters. It’s not about perfection, it’s about presence. 🌱



What do you all think? Have you noticed this trend too? Let’s discuss in the comments below! 👇



Edit: Wow, this blew up! Thanks for the gold, kind stranger! 🙏



Edit 2: To everyone saying this comment is AI — that’s exactly the kind of cynicism I’m talking about.
